# 马克·扎克伯格与迈向人工智能超级智能的驱动力

![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/d66e1c8058a992612906e0de6d78c549:83271fe2b84e5be5739f67042bca5685/mark-zuckerberg-meta.webp)

马克·扎克伯格，Meta首席执行官

在《AI杂志》2026年百大领袖榜单中排名第6，马克·扎克伯格正引领Meta的开源模型和超级智能雄心

马克·扎克伯格已成为人工智能领域的标志性人物之一，推动Meta塑造下一代智能系统。

马克刚刚在[AI杂志](https://aimagazine.com/)的2026年百大领袖榜单中排名第6，这显示了他对全球AI竞赛日益增长的影响力。

作为[Meta](https://aimagazine.com/company/meta)的首席执行官，他将公司定位在开放创新、多模态AI开发和追求人工通用智能（AGI）的前沿。

## 从Facebook到Meta

马克最初作为Facebook的联合创始人崭露头角，将其从一个学生平台转变为全球最强大的科技公司之一。

在二十年的时间里，他领导了这个组织——2021年更名为Meta——经历了数字通信、广告和沉浸式技术的重大转变。

![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jjwt-7Iov0k/hqdefault.jpg)

如今，他的注意力已果断转向AI，他正引领Meta度过其技术投资和转型中最雄心勃勃的时期之一。

他的领导力结合了长期愿景和快速执行，使Meta能够直接与[OpenAI](https://aimagazine.com/company/open-ai)、[Google](https://aimagazine.com/company/google)和[Anthropic](https://aimagazine.com/company/anthropic)等主要AI参与者竞争。

## 推动Meta的开源AI革命

马克在AI领域如此有影响力的最明显原因之一是Meta对开源开发的承诺。

2025年，公司推出了[其Llama大语言模型（LLM）家族的第四代](https://aimagazine.com/articles/what-metas-new-ai-models-mean-for-the-global-ai-race)，引入了Scout和Maverick，同时预览了规模更大的Behemoth。

这些模型设计用于从企业应用到内容创作和多模态处理的任务，意味着它们能够理解和生成文本、图像、视频和音频。

通过公开发布这些模型，Meta与那些模型通常被商业付费墙锁定的竞争对手区分开来。

马克认为，开放性加速创新，并确保全球开发者能够访问AI工具。

马克·扎克伯格和Meta正积极追求人工超级智能

## 构建超级智能和大规模投资

马克还通过Meta构建人工通用智能的雄心成为头条新闻。

Meta的战略包括重大收购和投资，例如其对Scale AI的143亿美元股份，将创始人Alexandr Wang带入高级领导角色。

此外，Meta刚刚宣布计划在一年内花费高达1350亿美元用于AI基础设施，强化了马克的信念，即AI将重新定义人们的工作和生活方式。

尽管一些高管警告存在AI泡沫，马克继续采取积极的投资方法，赌注AI将成为下一个时代的决定性技术。

从推进开源多模态模型到招募精英人才和投资数十亿美元于基础设施，马克·扎克伯格已成为塑造AI格局的最有影响力人物之一。

他的影响力超越Meta，帮助决定AI将如何在全球经济中构建、共享和部署。

# Mark Zuckerberg and the Drive Towards AI Superintelligence
By [Tom Chapman](https://aimagazine.com/author/tom-chapman)
January 29, 2026
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/d66e1c8058a992612906e0de6d78c549:83271fe2b84e5be5739f67042bca5685/mark-zuckerberg-meta.webp)
Mark Zuckerberg, CEO at Meta
Ranked No. 6 in AI Magazine’s Top 100 Leaders 2026 list, Mark Zuckerberg is steering Meta’s open source models and superintelligence ambitions
Mark Zuckerberg has emerged as one of the defining figures in artificial intelligence, driving Meta’s push to shape the next generation of intelligent systems.
Mark has just been ranked No. 6 on [AI Magazine](https://aimagazine.com/)’s list of the Top 100 Leaders 2026, demonstrating his growing impact on the global AI race.
As CEO of [Meta](https://aimagazine.com/company/meta), he has positioned the company at the forefront of open innovation, multimodal AI development and the pursuit of artificial general intelligence (AGI).
_**To read the Top 100 list in full, [click here](https://aimagazine.com/magazine/top-100-ai-leaders-2026).**_
## From Facebook to Meta
Mark first rose to prominence as co-founder of Facebook, transforming it from a student platform into one of the world’s most powerful technology companies.
Over the course of two decades, he has led the organisation – rebranded as Meta in 2021 – through major shifts in digital communication, advertising and immersive technologies.
![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jjwt-7Iov0k/hqdefault.jpg)
Today, his attention has turned decisively towards AI, where he is steering Meta through one of its most ambitious periods of technological investment and transformation.
His leadership combines long-term vision with fast execution, enabling Meta to compete directly with major AI players such as [OpenAI](https://aimagazine.com/company/open-ai), [Google](https://aimagazine.com/company/google) and [Anthropic](https://aimagazine.com/company/anthropic).
## Driving Meta’s open source AI revolution
One of the clearest reasons Mark is so influential in AI is Meta’s commitment to open source development.
In 2025, the company launched the [fourth iteration of its Llama large language model (LLM) family](https://aimagazine.com/articles/what-metas-new-ai-models-mean-for-the-global-ai-race), introducing Scout and Maverick, alongside a preview of the much larger Behemoth.
These models are designed for tasks ranging from enterprise applications to content creation and multimodal processing, meaning they can understand and generate across text, images, video and audio.
By releasing them openly, Meta has set itself apart from competitors whose models are often locked behind commercial paywalls.
Mark has argued that openness accelerates innovation and ensures AI tools are accessible to developers worldwide.
Mark Zuckerberg and Meta are aggressively pursuing artificial superintelligence
## Building superintelligence and investing at scale
Mark has also made headlines through Meta’s ambition to build artificial general intelligence.
Meta’s strategy has included major acquisitions and investments, such as its US$14.3bn stake in Scale AI, bringing founder Alexandr Wang into a senior leadership role.
What's more, Meta has just announced plans to spend up to US$135bn on AI infrastructure in a single year, reinforcing Mark's belief that AI will redefine how people work and live.
Despite warnings from some executives about an AI bubble, Mark continues to take an aggressive investment approach, betting that AI will be the defining technology of the next era.
From advancing open source multimodal models to recruiting elite talent and investing billions into infrastructure, Mark Zuckerberg has become one of the most powerful figures shaping the AI landscape.
His influence stretches beyond Meta, helping determine how AI will be built, shared and deployed across the global economy.
The Top 100 AI Leaders 2026 is out now
## The Top 100 AI Leaders 2026
The Top 100 AI Leaders 2026 recognises the individuals driving real-world impact through artificial intelligence, from scaling enterprise adoption to advancing responsible and ethical AI.
Our inaugural leaders list highlights the experts and executives who are shaping how AI is developed, governed and deployed across industries including technology, finance, healthcare, manufacturing and energy.
_**To read the Top 100 list in full, [click here](https://aimagazine.com/magazine/top-100-ai-leaders-2026).**_

# 花旗集团如何帮助员工驾驭人工智能的力量

![花旗银行是花旗集团的主要银行子公司。图片：Getty Images](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/8137e96a8aed0a18f80c5d28fab3a4cd:7a9afeee5da8a1cc5d2875b0186c1fbf/gettyimages-2231383651.webp)

花旗集团首席执行官简·弗雷泽揭示了这家金融服务巨头如何培训员工，并帮助他们理解与人工智能合作的好处。

人工智能正在引发董事会持续的辩论，企业领导者们权衡自动化是会消除工作岗位，还是会开辟新的机遇。

在最近世界经济论坛的达沃斯年会上，包括埃森哲的朱莉·斯威特和Salesforce的马克·贝尼奥夫在内的高管们讨论了教导员工与人工智能互动的重要性。现在，花旗集团首席执行官简·弗雷泽也加入了讨论，她认为公司培训员工的方式将决定人工智能是有益还是有害。

“人工智能有潜力带来巨大变革，”简在达沃斯会议期间告诉《华盛顿邮报》。“它将创造大量我们今天甚至无法想象的新工作。它将改变人们日常工作的性质。”

简表示，目前尚不清楚“得失是否会同时发生”，指的是工作岗位减少和增加之间的平衡，但她坚持认为员工必须尽可能“掌握主动权”。

她继续说道：“我们鼓励我们的员工，不是说人工智能会夺走你的工作，而是说使用人工智能的人可能会比你更擅长你的工作。”

## 基于伦理原则构建人工智能

花旗集团开始大规模使用人工智能，引入了一套旨在指导员工使用该技术的伦理原则框架。

简认为完全依赖规则过于僵化：“我喜欢用原则来帮助指导决策，因为我认为很难有完全基于规则的系统来指导人们。”

她倾向于一种灵活的方法，认识到工作中的人性因素。她解释了这种方法如何让员工以支持其角色和花旗集团客户的方式采用人工智能，强调实用性而非新奇性。

![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Mp-6gok9SPE/hqdefault.jpg)

“它如何帮助他们完成工作，”她说。“它如何更好地服务我们的客户，而不必过于拘泥。”

简接着强调了人工智能如何帮助她更高效地收集和总结信息。

## 实施人工智能优先的文化

随着花旗集团在其运营中嵌入人工智能，员工培训正迅速成为重中之重。

“它将在生活和工作中帮助他们，这就是为什么我们开始为每个人提供强制性培训，”简说。“有些人可能会对这些工具感到畏惧，所以让我们帮助消除恐惧的神话。”

这一全公司范围内的努力与花旗集团现代化其基础设施、提高效率和提供更好客户服务的计划相一致。

2025年，该组织开始为超过175,000名员工配备内部人工智能工具。最终，其“人工智能优先”方法旨在将技术嵌入每个层面——而不仅仅是专业部门。

花旗集团首席执行官简·弗雷泽表示，人工智能有潜力使员工在公司拥有长久的职业生涯。

简接着解释说，人工智能的采用可以在员工保留方面发挥作用，花旗集团所有新职位中有一半由现有员工填补。她以南达科他州的公司站点为例，那里许多员工在银行工作了30年，期间经历了12种不同的职业。

“我希望增加我们帮助人们（使用人工智能）重塑自己的机会，就像他们自己曾经做过的那样，”简补充道。她相信，让员工直接控制他们的人工智能学习有助于建立对未来角色的透明度。

# How Citigroup Helps Employees Harness the Power of AI
By [Tom Chapman](https://aimagazine.com/author/tom-chapman)
January 29, 2026
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/8137e96a8aed0a18f80c5d28fab3a4cd:7a9afeee5da8a1cc5d2875b0186c1fbf/gettyimages-2231383651.webp)
Citibank is the primary banking subsidiary of Citigroup. Picture: Getty Images
Jane Fraser, CEO at Citigroup, reveals how the finserv giant is training employees and helping them understand the benefits of working with AI
AI is prompting ongoing boardroom debates as business leaders weigh up whether automation stands to eliminate jobs or open up new opportunities.
At the World Economic Forum's recent [Annual Meeting in Davos](https://aimagazine.com/news/world-economic-forum-the-key-leadership-lessons-from-davos), executives including Accenture’s Julie Sweet and Salesforce’s Marc Benioff discussed the importance of teaching the workforce to interact with AI. Now, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser has joined the conversation, arguing the way companies train employees will shape whether AI proves helpful or harmful.
"AI has the potential to make tremendous changes," Jane told The Washington Post during the Davos meeting. “It’s going to create huge numbers of new jobs that we can’t even imagine what they are today. It will change the nature of what people do every day.”
Jane Fraser, CEO of Citigroup
Jane said it was unclear as to whether the "puts and takes are going to coincide," referring to the balance between job losses and gains, but insists workers must remain “as much in the driving seat as possible.”
She continued: "We're encouraging our people, saying not that AI is going to take your job away, but someone using AI is probably going to be better at your job than you are.”
## Building AI on ethical principles
[Citigroup](https://aimagazine.com/company/citigroup) began using AI at scale in AI, introducing a framework of ethical principles designed to guide employee use of the technology.
Jane believes relying entirely on rules is too rigid: “I like principles to help guide decision-making because I think it's hard to have entirely rules-based \[systems\] to guide people."
Her preference is for a flexible approach that recognises the human aspect of work. She explained how this method allows staff to adopt AI in ways that support both their roles and Citigroup’s customers, with an emphasis on utility rather than novelty.
![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Mp-6gok9SPE/hqdefault.jpg)
“How did it help them for their job," she said. "How did it serve our customers better without being precious about it."
Jane went on to highlight how AI assists her in gathering and summarising information more efficiently.
## Implementing an AI-first culture
As Citigroup embeds AI across its operations, [employee training](https://aimagazine.com/ai-strategy/sap-restructure-to-prioritise-ai-growth-and-upskilling-staff) is fast becoming a top priority.
“It will help them in life as well as at work, so that’s why we started having mandatory training for everyone,” said Jane. “Some people can get intimidated by the tools, so let’s help support getting rid of the myths of intimidation.”
This company-wide effort aligns with Citigroup’s plan to modernise its infrastructure, improve efficiency and deliver better customer service.
In 2025, the organisation began equipping more than 175,000 employees with internal AI tools. Ultimately, its “AI-first” approach aims to embed the technology at every level – not just in specialist departments.
Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser says AI has the potential to enable employees to have long careers at the company
Jane went on to explain that AI adoption can play a role in staff retention, with half of all new roles at Citigroup filled by current staff. She gives the example of the company’s site in South Dakota, where many employees have spent 30 years at the bank and experienced 12 different careers during that time.
“I want to stack the odds that we will help people reinvent themselves \[using AI\] the same way as they have done themselves,” added Jane. Her belief is that giving employees direct control over their AI learning helps build transparency about future roles.

# Pinterest 高管任命背后的 AI 驱动战略

Pinterest 首席执行官比尔·雷迪最近确认任命首席商务官李·布朗和首席营销官克劳丁·奇弗

Pinterest 对其高管团队的重组旨在推进其成为全球 AI 驱动购物平台的战略。

首席执行官比尔·雷迪最近确认任命两位新的高级领导人，李·布朗和克劳丁·奇弗，他们已担任关键角色，旨在锐化公司的商业和品牌战略。

![Lee Brown, Pinterest's first Chief Business Officer](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/8c637392831983a30e27b02093be96f3:ddde277e7610666821a472cfc9925c66/lee-brown.webp)

李已成为 Pinterest 的首位首席商务官，而克劳丁则加入担任首席营销官。两人都将直接向比尔汇报，比尔将这些变化视为公司下一个增长阶段的关键。

Pinterest 继续推进电子商务和广告业务，生成式 AI 支撑其商业路线图和定位。

![Bill Ready, CEO at Pinterest](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/2b1a6c3994d0807fb5e66ba944997034:06492a632cb7f68b26b3f85557017cc6/1765919125091-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-gqmyruzojyct5ccdowb5ryj8xk-x8cd2clb7dh1qn7q)

## 新的商业结构

李步入新创建的首席商务官角色，领导 Pinterest 面向客户的业务部门。这包括监督全球销售、广告、合作伙伴关系和内容。

作为重组的一部分，多个现有团队现在向李汇报，包括首席内容官马利克·杜卡德和领导广告产品营销的朱莉·汤斯。

![Julie Towns, VP of Product Marketing & Product Operations at Pinterest](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/9217f1936d6e31c91f647aa5fa1c76d0:c7338dd088a3b07ebed36bb97f9502a2/1668063926415-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-akxd9gd3ydocfdr3mbz8qocu7-vrnvplm6fr1t3xnu4)

比尔表示，引入首席商务官角色是为了统一 Pinterest 的客户运营并扩大收入机会。

他告诉 Axios：“新的首席商务官角色在我们拥有许多新收入机会的时刻，将所有面向客户的接触点整合在一起。”

李在围绕用户参与度构建商业模型方面拥有丰富的经验，他表示：“无论是 Spotify、DoorDash 还是 BuzzFeed——在所有这些公司，我都通过深化客户关系、客户运营和内容合作伙伴关系，将消费者需求转化为强大的广告机会。”

回顾他在 DoorDash 的任期，他补充道：“它让我亲眼目睹了世界级运营商如何执行。”

李的到来恰逢长期首席营收官比尔·沃特金斯的离职，他在公司工作了十多年后离开。

![Bill Watkins, Pinterest's Chief Revenue Officer](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/3cb37a49a194243628a1591e0b64e04f:bde48fcd565e1ac937707fa1df11b409/1694721547014-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-bi2ioz4eev2oksnikc154jy-yfmdb-4-5vyxpc2ckoq)

## 用积极的 AI 塑造品牌

克劳丁从亚马逊加入，她在那里工作了十年，领导多个部门的营销工作。作为首席营销官，她的任务是完善 Pinterest 的市场叙事，并随着平台进一步深入 AI 主导的购物和电子商务，扩展其信息传递。

比尔认为克劳丁的角色对于更清晰地讲述 Pinterest 的市场定位至关重要：“我们认为，从营销角度来看，有一个更好的故事可以讲述，伴随着购物和商业化增长。”

克劳丁的重点将放在 Pinterest 如何应用 AI 来个性化内容，同时不损害用户舒适度。

她说：“我们真的可以自动化和个性化这种相关性，它永远不会让人感到毛骨悚然或奇怪。它会感觉丰富和有用。”

![Claudine Cheever, appointed Chief Marketing Officer at Pinterest](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/c2af4918c53eb76572a5358178f03f91:7a3cc8c307055b91990fc8dc09386096/1722527904102-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-t03tsy33hdgy15cmdkysslzkh9l50osi-iiqdwu26ge)

比尔说：“通过调整 AI 以追求积极性，并拒绝通过激怒来吸引参与，” Pinterest 可以成为一个“能够创造更多”的品牌。

克劳丁还将监督一个正在开发的新消费者营销活动。该活动旨在突出 Pinterest 作为一个用户可以通过视觉发现浏览和购物的目的地，将其定位为一个比竞争对手更活跃和有用的平台。

## 触及年轻受众

新聘人员与 Pinterest 扩大其商业覆盖范围，特别是在年轻受众中的更广泛努力保持一致。

![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/u1GtdacoVWA/hqdefault.jpg)

Z 世代在 Pinterest 的全球用户群中占比越来越大。在比尔的领导下，该平台已连续九个季度实现用户增长，全球月活跃用户超过 6 亿。

比尔在 LinkedIn 上写道：“在过去的三年半里，我们在 Pinterest 取得了重大进展：达到了创纪录的 6 亿月活跃用户，将 Pinterest 转变为 AI 驱动的购物目的地和效果广告平台。我们在做这一切的同时，将积极性和用户福祉置于我们存在的核心。

“这是我们继续在全球范围内发展业务的重要时刻。我相信，随着李和克劳丁的加入，我们将达到新的高度，并继续赢得市场份额。”

随着更多用户寻求结合相关性、实用性和情感舒适度的在线体验，Pinterest 正借助 AI 来连接发现与商业。其高管重组支持这一方向，重点关注货币化、用户体验和持续的全球增长。

# The AI-Powered Strategy Behind Pinterest's C-Suite Additions
By [Tom Chapman](https://aimagazine.com/author/tom-chapman)
January 29, 2026
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/138/8c637392831983a30e27b02093be96f3:ddde277e7610666821a472cfc9925c66/lee-brown.webp)
Lee Brown, Pinterest's first Chief Business Officer
Pinterest CEO Bill Ready recently confirmed the appointment of Chief Business Officer (CBO) Lee Brown and Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) Claudine Cheever
[Pinterest](https://aimagazine.com/company/pinterest)'s reorganisation of its executive team is designed to advance its strategy to become a global platform for AI-powered shopping.
CEO Bill Ready recently confirmed the appointment of two new senior leaders, Lee Brown and Claudine Cheever, who have taken on key roles aimed at sharpening the company's commercial and brand strategy.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/2b1a6c3994d0807fb5e66ba944997034:06492a632cb7f68b26b3f85557017cc6/1765919125091-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-gqmyruzojyct5ccdowb5ryj8xk-x8cd2clb7dh1qn7q)
Bill Ready, CEO at Pinterest
Lee has become Pinterest’s first Chief Business Officer (CBO), while Claudine has joined as Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). Both will report directly to Bill, who frames the changes as essential to the company’s next growth phase.
Pinterest continues to push into e-commerce and advertising, with [Gen AI](https://aimagazine.com/news/top-10-generative-ai-tools) underpinning its commercial roadmap and positioning.
## A new commercial structure
Lee steps into the newly-created CBO role to lead Pinterest's customer-facing business units. This includes oversight of global sales, advertising, partnerships and content.
As part of the restructure, multiple existing teams now report into Lee, including Chief Content Officer Malik Ducard and Julie Towns, who leads advertising product marketing.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/9217f1936d6e31c91f647aa5fa1c76d0:c7338dd088a3b07ebed36bb97f9502a2/1668063926415-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-akxd9gd3ydocfdr3mbz8qocu7-vrnvplm6fr1t3xnu4)
Julie Towns, VP of Product Marketing & Product Operations at Pinterest
Bill says the CBO role has been introduced to unify Pinterest’s customer operations and scale revenue opportunities.
"The new Chief Business Officer role brings together all customer-facing touch-points at a moment where we have a number of new revenue opportunities," he told Axios.
Lee brings ample experience building commercial models around user engagement, stating: "Whether it's [Spotify](https://aimagazine.com/news/spotify-partnering-with-labels-for-ai-music-products), DoorDash or BuzzFeed – at all of these companies, I've turned consumer demand to strong advertising opportunities by deepening client relationships, customer operations and content partnerships."
Reflecting on his tenure at DoorDash, he adds: "It gave me a front row seat to how world-class operators execute."
Lee's arrival coincides with the departure of long-time Chief Revenue Officer Bill Watkins, who leaves the company after more than 10 years.
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/3cb37a49a194243628a1591e0b64e04f:bde48fcd565e1ac937707fa1df11b409/1694721547014-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-bi2ioz4eev2oksnikc154jy-yfmdb-4-5vyxpc2ckoq)
Bill Watkins, Pinterest's Chief Revenue Officer
## Shaping the brand with positive AI
Claudine joins from Amazon, where she led marketing across various divisions during her 10-year stint. In her role as CMO, she is tasked with refining Pinterest’s market narrative and expanding its messaging as the platform leans further into AI-led shopping and e-commerce.
Bill sees Claudine’s role as essential to telling a clearer story around Pinterest’s market position: "We think there's a much better story for us to tell, [from a marketing perspective](https://aimagazine.com/top10/top-10-ai-driven-marketing), that goes along with that shopping and commercialisation growth."
Claudine focus will be on how Pinterest applies AI to personalise content without compromising user comfort.
"We can really automate and personalise that relevance, and it will never feel creepy or weird," she says. "It will feel rich and useful."
![](https://assets.bizclikmedia.net/668/c2af4918c53eb76572a5358178f03f91:7a3cc8c307055b91990fc8dc09386096/1722527904102-e-1770854400-v-beta-t-t03tsy33hdgy15cmdkysslzkh9l50osi-iiqdwu26ge)
Claudine Cheever, appointed Chief Marketing Officer at Pinterest
"By tuning AI for positivity and rejecting engagement via enragement," Bill says, Pinterest can be a brand "that can make a lot more".
Claudine will also oversees a new consumer marketing campaign in development. The campaign aims to highlight Pinterest as a destination where users can both browse and shop through visual discovery, positioning it as a more active and useful platform compared to competitors.
## Reaching a younger audience
The new hires align with Pinterest’s broader bid to expand its [commercial reach](https://aimagazine.com/news/why-is-microsoft-ceo-satya-nadella-shifting-his-focus-to-ai), particularly among younger audiences.
![Youtube Placeholder](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/u1GtdacoVWA/hqdefault.jpg)
Gen Z accounts for a growing portion of Pinterest’s global user base. Under Bill's leadership, the platform has recorded nine consecutive quarters of user growth, with more than 600 million monthly active users worldwide.
Writing on LinkedIn, Bill added: "Over the past three-and-a-half years, we've made significant progress at Pinterest: reaching a record 600 million MAU, turning Pinterest into an AI-powered shopping destination and performance ad platform. We've done all of this while putting positivity and user well-being at the centre of our reason for being.
"It's an important moment for us as we continue to grow our business globally. I’m confident that, with the addition of Lee and Claudine, we will reach new heights and continue to win market share."
As more users seek online experiences that combine relevance, utility and emotional comfort, Pinterest is leaning into AI to bridge discovery with commerce. Its executive restructure supports this direction, with a focus on monetisation, user experience and sustained global growth.
